pugixml v1.14 (MIT): https://github.com/zeux/pugixml/tree/v1.14
Bundled to support Ubuntu releases whose system pugixml is too old.

Additional compatibility changes: initialize pre-1.1 OpenSSL algorithms; add
missing pre-3.0 provider placeholder; OpenSSL 1.0 BIO const signature; libzip
0.10 type/API aliases; explicit unsigned-byte overload for GCC 4.8/5.
